text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Pittsburgh Steelers for their 2026 home opener at Gillette Stadium this Sunday at 1 PM ET, the team faces a significant challenge in the absence of wide receiver A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 and has been placed on injured reserve for a minimum of four games, leaving the question of who steps up in his absence front and center heading into the game. Off the field, there's been plenty of positive news: Drake Maye and his wife Ann Michael donated generously to Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence by fulfilling Amazon classroom wish lists for more than 50 teachers and support specialists, while the Kraft family and Patriots Foundation donated $275,000 in the names of this year's Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, with volunteer Susie Shaw of Carlisle receiving the $25,000 grand prize for William's Be Yourself Challenge. In roster news, the Patriots re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad while releasing tight end Shane Zylstra from the practice squad. Additionally, Patriots owner Robert Kraft made clear the organization's values by having Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming Gillette Stadium shows, citing concerns over what he described as the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery."
